JOHN LESTER TAN MALACK TAN Punong Barangay Barangay South Poblacion Municipality of Maramag, Province of Bukidnon Dear Punong Barangay Tan: This has reference to your letter concerning Sangguniang Barangay Resolution No. 2024- 0551 , requesting this Department's approval on the utilization of the national wealth share of Brgy. South Poblacion, Maramag, Province of Bukidnon, from the National Power Corporation-Pulangi IV HEP for the installation of a Solar Power System in the Barangay Hall Compound. It is intimated that the installation of a solar power system is intended to "promote sustainable energy use within your community, reduce electricity costs, and contribute to environmental conservation." In response thereto, please be apprised that utilization of the LGU's national wealth share is not subject to approval by this Department. However, it is hereby emphasized that the utilization of the share of local government unit (LGU) in the proceeds from the national wealth must be pursuant to Section 294 of Republic Act No. 7160, or the Local Government Code, thus: "Section 294. Development and Livelihood Projects. - The proceeds from the share of local government units pursuant to this chapter shall be appropriated by their respective sanggunian to finance local government and livelihood projects: Provided, however, that at least eighty percent (80%) of the proceeds derived from the development and utilization of hydrothermal. geothermal, and other sources of energy shall be applied solely to lower the cost of electricity in the local government unit where such a source of enerqy is located." (Emphasis supplied) The afore-cited provision is explicit that the LGU's share must be utilized to finance local development and livelihood projects and that at least of the proceeds derived from the development and utilization of hydrothermal, geothermal, and other sources of energy must be utilized exclusively to fund projects or mechanisms that directly reduce electricity costs. t "A Resolution Authorizing the Utilization of the National Power Corporation — Pulangi IV HEP National Wealth Share for the Installation of a Solar Power System in the Barangay Hall Compound of Barangay South Poblacion." "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan"

We hope to have guided you on the matter. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY ATTY. ROMEO P. BENITEZ Undersecretary for External, Legal and Legislative Affairs Page 2 of 2
